record.bible_text: Now Naaman<WH05283>, captain<WH08269> of the host<WH06635> of the king<WH04428> of Syria<WH0758>, was a great<WH01419> man<WH0376> with<WH06440> his master<WH0113>, and honourable<WH05375><WTH8803>, because by him the LORD<WH03068> had given<WH05414><WTH8804> deliverance<WH08668> unto Syria<WH0758>: he was also a mighty<WH01368> man<WH0376> in valour<WH02428>, <FI>but he was<Fi> a leper<WH06879><WTH8794>. <RF>with: Heb. before<Rf> <RF>honourable: or, gracious: Heb. lifted up, or, accepted in countenance<Rf> <RF>deliverance: or, victory<Rf>

And the Syrians<WH0758> had gone out<WH03318><WTH8804> by companies<WH01416>, and had brought away captive<WH07617><WTH8799> out of the land<WH0776> of Israel<WH03478> a little<WH06996> maid<WH05291>; and she waited on<WH06440> Naaman's<WH05283> wife<WH0802>. <RF>waited...: Heb. was before<Rf>

And she said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto her mistress<WH01404>, Would<WH0305> God my lord<WH0113> <FI>were<Fi> with<WH06440> the prophet<WH05030> that <FI>is<Fi> in Samaria<WH08111>! for<WH0227> he would recover<WH0622><WTH8799> him of his leprosy<WH06883>. <RF>with: Heb. before<Rf> <RF>recover: Heb. gather in<Rf>

And <FI>one<Fi> went in<WH0935><WTH8799>, and told<WH05046><WTH8686> his lord<WH0113>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Thus and thus said<WH01696><WTH8765> the maid<WH05291> that <FI>is<Fi> of the land<WH0776> of Israel<WH03478>.

And the king<WH04428> of Syria<WH0758> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Go to<WH03212><WTH8798>, go<WH0935><WTH8798>, and I will send<WH07971><WTH8799> a letter<WH05612> unto the king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478>. And he departed<WH03212><WTH8799>, and took<WH03947><WTH8799> with him<WH03027> ten<WH06235> talents<WH03603> of silver<WH03701>, and six<WH08337> thousand<WH0505> <FI>pieces<Fi> of gold<WH02091>, and ten<WH06235> changes<WH02487> of raiment<WH0899>. <RF>with...: Heb. in his hand<Rf>

And he brought<WH0935><WTH8686> the letter<WH05612> to the king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Now when this letter<WH05612> is come<WH0935><WTH8800> unto thee, behold, I have <FI>therewith<Fi> sent<WH07971><WTH8804> Naaman<WH05283> my servant<WH05650> to thee, that thou mayest recover<WH0622><WTH8804> him of his leprosy<WH06883>.

And it came to pass, when the king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478> had read<WH07121><WTH8800> the letter<WH05612>, that he rent<WH07167><WTH8799> his clothes<WH0899>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>Am<Fi> I God<WH0430>, to kill<WH04191><WTH8687> and to make alive<WH02421><WTH8687>, that this man<WH02088> doth send<WH07971><WTH8802> unto me to recover<WH0622><WTH8800> a man<WH0376> of his leprosy<WH06883>? wherefore<WH0389> consider<WH03045><WTH8798>, I pray you, and see<WH07200><WTH8798> how he seeketh a quarrel<WH0579><WTH8693> against me.

And it was <FI>so<Fi> , when Elisha<WH0477> the man<WH0376> of God<WH0430> had heard<WH08085><WTH8800> that the king<WH04428> of Israel<WH03478> had rent<WH07167><WTH8804> his clothes<WH0899>, that he sent<WH07971><WTH8799> to the king<WH04428>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Wherefore hast thou rent<WH07167><WTH8804> thy clothes<WH0899>? let him come<WH0935><WTH8799> now to me, and he shall know<WH03045><WTH8799> that there is<WH03426> a prophet<WH05030> in Israel<WH03478>.<CM>
So Naaman<WH05283> came<WH0935><WTH8799> with his horses<WH05483> and with his chariot<WH07393>, and stood<WH05975><WTH8799> at the door<WH06607> of the house<WH01004> of Elisha<WH0477>.

And Elisha<WH0477> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> a messenger<WH04397> unto him, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Go<WH01980><WTH8800> and wash<WH07364><WTH8804> in Jordan<WH03383> seven<WH07651> times<WH06471>, and thy flesh<WH01320> shall come again<WH07725><WTH8799> to thee, and thou shalt be clean<WH02891><WTH8798>.

But Naaman<WH05283> was wroth<WH07107><WTH8799>, and went away<WH03212><WTH8799>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Behold, I thought<WH0559><WTH8804>, He will surely<WH03318><WTH8800> come out<WH03318><WTH8799> to me, and stand<WH05975><WTH8804>, and call<WH07121><WTH8804> on the name<WH08034> of the LORD<WH03068> his God<WH0430>, and strike<WH05130><WTH8689> his hand<WH03027> over the place<WH04725>, and recover<WH0622><WTH8804> the leper<WH06879><WTH8794>. <RF>I thought: Heb. I said<Rf> <RF>I thought...: or, I said with myself, He will surely come out, etc: Heb. I said<Rf> <RF>strike: Heb. move up and down<Rf>

<FI> Are<Fi> not Abana<WH071><WTH8676><WH0549> and Pharpar<WH06554>, rivers<WH05104> of Damascus<WH01834>, better<WH02896> than all the waters<WH04325> of Israel<WH03478>? may I not wash<WH07364><WTH8799> in them, and be clean<WH02891><WTH8804>? So he turned<WH06437><WTH8799> and went away<WH03212><WTH8799> in a rage<WH02534>. <RF>Abana: or, Amana<Rf>

And his servants<WH05650> came near<WH05066><WTH8799>, and spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto him, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, My father<WH01>, <FI>if<Fi> the prophet<WH05030> had bid<WH01696><WTH8765> thee <FI>do some<Fi> great<WH01419> thing<WH01697>, wouldest thou not have done<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>it<Fi> ? how much rather then<WH0637>, when he saith<WH0559><WTH8804> to thee, Wash<WH07364><WTH8798>, and be clean<WH02891><WTH8798>?

Then went he down<WH03381><WTH8799>, and dipped<WH02881><WTH8799> himself seven<WH07651> times<WH06471> in Jordan<WH03383>, according to the saying<WH01697> of the man<WH0376> of God<WH0430>: and his flesh<WH01320> came again<WH07725><WTH8799> like unto the flesh<WH01320> of a little<WH06996> child<WH05288>, and he was clean<WH02891><WTH8799>.<CM>

And he returned<WH07725><WTH8799> to the man<WH0376> of God<WH0430>, he and all his company<WH04264>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799>, and stood<WH05975><WTH8799> before<WH06440> him: and he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Behold, now I know<WH03045><WTH8804> that <FI> there is<Fi> no God<WH0430> in all the earth<WH0776>, but in Israel<WH03478>: now therefore, I pray thee, take<WH03947><WTH8798> a blessing<WH01293> of thy servant<WH05650>.

But he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>As<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, before<WH06440> whom I stand<WH05975><WTH8804>, I will receive<WH03947><WTH8799> none. And he urged<WH06484><WTH8799> him to take<WH03947><WTH8800> <FI>it<Fi> ; but he refused<WH03985><WTH8762>.

And Naaman<WH05283> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Shall there not then, I pray thee, be given<WH05414><WTH8714> to thy servant<WH05650> two<WH06776> mules<WH06505>' burden<WH04853> of earth<WH0127>? for thy servant<WH05650> will henceforth offer<WH06213><WTH8799> neither burnt offering<WH05930> nor sacrifice<WH02077> unto other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>, but unto the LORD<WH03068>.

In this thing<WH01697> the LORD<WH03068> pardon<WH05545><WTH8799> thy servant<WH05650>, <FI>that<Fi> when my master<WH0113> goeth<WH0935><WTH8800> into the house<WH01004> of Rimmon<WH07417> to worship<WH07812><WTH8692> there, and he leaneth<WH08172><WTH8737> on my hand<WH03027>, and I bow<WH07812><WTH8694> myself in the house<WH01004> of Rimmon<WH07417>: when I bow down<WH07812><WTH8692> myself in the house<WH01004> of Rimmon<WH07417>, the LORD<WH03068> pardon<WH05545><WTH8799> thy servant<WH05650> in this thing<WH01697>.

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Go<WH03212><WTH8798> in peace<WH07965>. So he departed<WH03212><WTH8799> from him a little<WH03530> way<WH0776>. <RF>a little...: Heb. a little piece of ground<Rf><CM>

But Gehazi<WH01522>, the servant<WH05288> of Elisha<WH0477> the man<WH0376> of God<WH0430>, said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Behold, my master<WH0113> hath spared<WH02820><WTH8804> Naaman<WH05283> this Syrian<WH0761>, in not receiving<WH03947><WTH8800> at his hands<WH03027> that which he brought<WH0935><WTH8689>: but, <FI>as<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>, I will run<WH07323><WTH8804> after<WH0310> him, and take<WH03947><WTH8804> somewhat<WH03972> of him.

So Gehazi<WH01522> followed<WH07291><WTH8799> after<WH0310> Naaman<WH05283>. And when Naaman<WH05283> saw<WH07200><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> running<WH07323><WTH8801> after<WH0310> him, he lighted down<WH05307><WTH8799> from the chariot<WH04818> to meet<WH07125><WTH8800> him, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, <FI>Is<Fi> all well<WH07965>? <RF>Is...: Heb. Is there peace?<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, All <FI>is<Fi> well<WH07965>. My master<WH0113> hath sent<WH07971><WTH8804> me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Behold, even now there be come<WH0935><WTH8804> to me from mount<WH02022> Ephraim<WH0669> two<WH08147> young men<WH05288> of the sons<WH01121> of the prophets<WH05030>: give<WH05414><WTH8798> them, I pray thee, a talent<WH03603> of silver<WH03701>, and two<WH08147> changes<WH02487> of garments<WH0899>.

And Naaman<WH05283> said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Be content<WH02974><WTH8685>, take<WH03947><WTH8798> two talents<WH03603>. And he urged<WH06555><WTH8799> him, and bound<WH06696><WTH8799> two<WH08147> talents<WH03603> of silver<WH03701> in two<WH08147> bags<WH02754>, with two<WH08147> changes<WH02487> of garments<WH0899>, and laid<WH05414><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> upon two<WH08147> of his servants<WH05288>; and they bare<WH05375><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> before<WH06440> him.

And when he came<WH0935><WTH8799> to the tower<WH06076>, he took<WH03947><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> from their hand<WH03027>, and bestowed<WH06485><WTH8799> <FI>them<Fi> in the house<WH01004>: and he let the men<WH0582> go<WH07971><WTH8762>, and they departed<WH03212><WTH8799>. <RF>tower: or, secret place<Rf>

But he went in<WH0935><WTH8802>, and stood<WH05975><WTH8799> before his master<WH0113>. And Elisha<WH0477> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Whence<WH0370> <FI>comest thou<Fi> , Gehazi<WH01522>? And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Thy servant<WH05650> went<WH01980><WTH8804> no whither<WH0575>. <RF>no whither: Heb. not hither or thither<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Went<WH01980><WTH8804> not mine heart<WH03820> <FI>with thee<Fi> , when the man<WH0376> turned<WH02015><WTH8804> again from his chariot<WH04818> to meet<WH07125><WTH8800> thee? <FI>Is it<Fi> a time<WH06256> to receive<WH03947><WTH8800> money<WH03701>, and to receive<WH03947><WTH8800> garments<WH0899>, and oliveyards<WH02132>, and vineyards<WH03754>, and sheep<WH06629>, and oxen<WH01241>, and menservants<WH05650>, and maidservants<WH08198>?

The leprosy<WH06883> therefore of Naaman<WH05283> shall cleave<WH01692><WTH8799> unto thee, and unto thy seed<WH02233> for ever<WH05769>. And he went out<WH03318><WTH8799> from his presence<WH06440> a leper<WH06879><WTH8794> <FI>as white<Fi> as snow<WH07950>.<CM>
